summary: Saving a DFM is much faster on network-drive projects.
details: Dependency discovery now enumerates a reserving-class folder once per pass and reads its sidecars with bounded parallelism instead of one sidecar per cached CSV in sequence.
Measured on a 119-dataset reserving class, a save issued 316 file reads before and 195 after; simulating an 8 ms network round trip, one save fell from about 3.3 s to about 1.4 s.
Saved files, chosen dependencies, and propagation results are unchanged.
